arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body neutral character sprite of Albedo from Genshin Impact for a visual novel. Image 1 is the user-supplied official artwork, the primary reference for his identity, hair, face, outfit, colors and detailed anime illustration rendering. Image 2 is the user-supplied in-game model, a secondary reference for his hairstyle, costume construction and natural hanging coat panels. Preserve his pale skin, teal eyes, light blond hair and distinctive navy, white and gold alchemist outfit. Give him the project's petite Medium Male anime build, compact and youthful rather than tall or long-legged. Draw a calm, neutral expression, both eyes open, one coherent closed mouth, and a relaxed natural standing pose with arms at his sides. Hands should be simple and naturally articulated, each a complete human hand with a palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb, naturally separated from clothing. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet slightly separated. Full figure including all hair, hands, coat tails and shoes, framed at about 92–96% of image height with a little padding at top and bottom. Crisp polished anime game illustration with detailed costume and clean edges. Transparent background with genuine alpha. No sword, scenery, text, labels, watermark, floating effects or ground shadow.
